datasets.name: b3edb8de
queryLines:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_runas_escalation t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')) AS value,
       concat(CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(event_count), 0) FROM r WHERE status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')) AS STRING), ' events; worst: ',
              COALESCE((SELECT concat(run_by, ' running as ', run_as) FROM r WHERE status IN ('CRITICAL', 'WARN')
                        ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 1), 'none')) AS target

datasets.name: 26d50921
queryLines:
WITH i AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_network_inbound_denials t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))),
     o AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_network_outbound_denials t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(denial_count), 0) FROM i) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(denial_count), 0) FROM o) AS value,
       'Inbound + outbound, blocked by IP access list or network policy' AS target

datasets.name: 36a1defd
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'access_broad_grants', 'Overly broad grants', 'Access & grants'),
       (1, 'access_grants_inventory', 'Grants inventory', 'Access & grants'),
       (2, 'access_grants_inventory_extended', 'Grants inventory, extended', 'Access & grants'),
       (3, 'access_runas_escalation', 'Run-as identity escalation', 'Access & grants'),
       (4, 'access_login_concentration', 'Login concentration', 'Access & grants'),
       (5, 'access_network_inbound_denials', 'Inbound network denials', 'Access & grants'),
       (6, 'access_network_outbound_denials', 'Outbound network denials', 'Access & grants')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: 74a298ca
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), NULL) AS `workspace_shown`,
  t.`status` AS `status`,
  t.`service_name` AS `service_name`,
  t.`action_name` AS `action_name`,
  t.`run_by` AS `run_by`,
  t.`run_as` AS `run_as`,
  t.`delegation_kind` AS `delegation_kind`,
  CAST(t.`newly_seen_pair` AS STRING) AS `newly_seen_pair`,
  t.`event_count` AS `event_count`,
  date_format(t.`first_event_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `first_event_time`,
  date_format(t.`last_event_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `last_event_time`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_runas_escalation t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY CASE `status` WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 WHEN 'OK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, `event_count` DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

  t.`status` AS `status`,
  t.`table_catalog` AS `table_catalog`,
  t.`table_schema` AS `table_schema`,
  t.`table_name` AS `table_name`,
  t.`sensitivity_basis` AS `sensitivity_basis`,
  t.`reader` AS `reader`,
  t.`table_owner` AS `table_owner`,
  t.`read_count` AS `read_count`,
  date_format(t.`first_read_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `first_read_time`,

datasets.name: 6448dc41
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'access_table_lineage_blast_radius', 'Table lineage blast radius', 'Lineage'),
       (1, 'access_column_lineage_sensitive_reach', 'Sensitive column lineage reach', 'Lineage'),
       (2, 'access_pii_propagation_untagged', 'PII propagating into untagged tables', 'Lineage'),
       (3, 'access_views_inventory', 'Views inventory', 'Lineage'),
       (4, 'access_volumes_inventory', 'Volumes inventory', 'Lineage')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord
